name: Adjustable camber bolts
_note: Eccentric bolts in the struts' mounts: the wheels' camber set at the front and the rear (Tuning). A little negative camber (the tops in) keeps the loaded outside tyre flatter on the road as the body rolls, for more grip in corners, and costs a little braking and traction; too much and the tyres grip less every way (physics/vehicle.js #camber). The wheels lean as set, in the garage and on the road.
